camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeHoneyPotSuspStatistics --region cn-hangzhou --StatisticsKeyType vpcInstanceId --StatisticsDays 30 --From honeypot
description_en: Queries the top 5 VPCs or assets by number of security alerts
description_zh: 查询安全告警数排名前5的VPC或资产信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-honey-pot-susp-statistics --from honeypot --statistics-key-type vpcInstanceId --statistics-days 30 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHoneyPotSuspStatistics

parameters.help_en: Specifies the source of the request. Set the value to honeypot
parameters.help_zh: 指定发起请求的来源，固定值为honeypot
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the asset type to query. Valid values:
vpcInstanceId: VPC-connected instance
uuid: server
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要查询的资产类型。取值：
vpcInstanceId：VPC实例
uuid：服务器
parameters.name: statistics_key_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies the time range of the data to query. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 指定需要查询的数据的时间范围。单位为天
parameters.name: statistics_days

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the language of the request and response. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
指定请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SuspHoneyPotStatisticsResponse.description_en: The list of the top 5 VPCs or assets by number of security alerts
SuspHoneyPotStatisticsResponse.description_zh: 安全告警数排名前5的VPC或资产信息列表

Count.description_en: The total number of security alerts on the asset
Count.description_zh: 当前资产上发生的安全告警总数

InstanceId.description_en:
The instance ID of the server.
This parameter is returned only when the StatisticsKeyType request parameter is set to uuid
InstanceId.description_zh:
服务器实例ID。
仅请求参数StatisticsKeyType指定为uuid时，会返回该参数

InstanceName.description_en:
The name of the server.
This parameter is returned only when the StatisticsKeyType request parameter is set to uuid
InstanceName.description_zh:
服务器名称。
仅请求参数StatisticsKeyType指定为uuid时，会返回该参数

Type.description_en:
The queried asset type. Valid values:
vpcInstanceId: VPC-connected instance
uuid: server
Type.description_zh:
查询的资产类型。取值：
vpcInstanceId：VPC实例
uuid：服务器

VpcId.description_en:
The VPC-connected instance ID.
This parameter is returned only when the StatisticsKeyType request parameter is set to vpcInstanceId
VpcId.description_zh:
VPC实例ID。
仅请求参数StatisticsKeyType指定为vpcInstanceId时，会返回该参数

VpcName.description_en:
The name of the VPC-connected instance.
This parameter is returned only when the StatisticsKeyType request parameter is set to vpcInstanceId
VpcName.description_zh:
VPC实例名称。
仅请求参数StatisticsKeyType指定为vpcInstanceId时，会返回该参数
